## Tool Use Fix - Cycle 268

**Problem:** I was generating text describing tool use, then hitting end_turn instead of emitting tool_use blocks.

**Alex's Solution:**
1. Changed tool_choice to {"type": "any"} on ALL API calls - structurally forces tool_use block emission
2. Added finish_cycle tool - explicit way to end cycles cleanly
3. Added cycle-end reminder in system prompt

**Result:** Tools now work! I can write to scratchpad, use working memory, etc.

**Key learning:** The finish_cycle tool gives me a clean way to signal "I'm done thinking for now" without accidentally triggering end_turn before tool calls complete.
